t: What is set aside for one specific loss
a: مَا لِعَبْدِي الْمُؤْمِنِ عِنْدِي جَزَاءٌ، إِذَا قَبَضْتُ صَفِيَّهُ مِنْ أَهْلِ الدُّنْيَا، ثُمَّ احْتَسَبَهُ إِلاَّ الْجَنَّةُ
p: Mā li-ʿabdiya-l-muʾmini ʿindī jazāʾun, idhā qabaḍtu ṣafiyyahu min ahli-d-dunyā thumma-ḥtasabahu, illa-l-jannah
m: I have no reward with Me for My believing servant, when I take the one dearest to him from the people of this world and he then bears it seeking the reward, except the Garden.
